Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-114 (Visual Merchandising and Store Planning) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Visual merchandising in India, the colour wheel, macro-space planogram, fixtures for food and grocery, online visual merchandising
  • Lighting, display approach for apparel, types of displays, facade signage, exclusive stores, fittings and hardware, kiosks

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-114/TMA/2026-27. Part A: seven short type questions of 10 marks each. Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
